title: T-RFLP Sephadex Purification and Sample Preparation
author: Eva Petrova

steps.title: Prepare Sephadex Filter Plates
steps.instruction: Load Sephadex solution onto 96 well filter plates and assemble the plate sandwich.

substeps.instruction: Shake the Sephadex solution well before usage.
Load 200μl Sephadex solution onto the 96 well filter plates using an Eppendorf Multipette with a 10ml tip.
Place the filter plate on a 96 well collection plate.
Place the lid on top of the plate sandwich and place it in a swing-out rotor base.

steps.title: Centrifuge Sephadex Solution
steps.instruction: Spin the plate sandwich to set the Sephadex gel.

substeps.instruction: Balance the centrifuge with a dummy plate sandwich.
Spin at 230 rcf (g) for 1 min 15 sec (Eppendorf centrifuge 5810).
Repeat this centrifugation step once more, shaking the Sephadex solution again before the second load if applicable.

steps.title: Load Samples onto Sephadex
steps.instruction: Apply the sample to the top of the Sephadex G-50 gel.

substeps.instruction: Place the Sephadex G-50 containing 96 well filter plate on the collection plate.
Carefully drop 20μl of sample into the center of the Sephadex column, avoiding penetration of the gel with the pipette tip.

steps.title: Purify Samples by Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Spin the samples through the Sephadex gel to collect purified fractions.

substeps.instruction: Spin at 420 rcf (g) for 1 min (Eppendorf centrifuge 5810).
Note that the total sample volume will be approximately 35-40 μl due to extra buffer.

steps.title: Clean and Recover Samples
steps.instruction: Clean the hardware and store the purified samples.

substeps.instruction: Remove the Sephadex from the filter plate.
Rinse the filter plate and collection plate with MQ water.
Transfer the purified samples back to the original caps.
Proceed immediately to sample preparation or store samples at -20°C.

steps.title: Prepare Samples for Sequencing
steps.instruction: Mix purified samples with HiDi Formamide master mix and denature.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot 10μl of HiDi Formamide master mix into a new 96 well plate.
Add 4μl of purified sample per well.
Denature samples for 3 min at 95°C.
Transfer samples immediately to ice and chill for 5 min.
Store samples in the fridge.
Prepare the sample sheet.
Run the samples at an ABI 3130XL Capillary Sequencer.
